card.name: Words just before vitamin D and calcium terms
card.fires_on: Small words, spaces or digits that sit right before a vitamin D, calcium or bone-disease term in drug-label text. Examples are 'the' before 'risk of hypercalcemia' and 'of' before 'vitamin D'.

modes.label: Linking word before vitamin D
modes.description: A small linking word such as of, including or other that comes just before 'vitamin D' or a related term.

modes.description: A blank space or digit just before a section number, CKD stage or lab name like 25-hydroxyvitamin D.
